title: S01-02 - The Overturned Vendor Cart
hook: A vendor cart lies sideways across the road. Produce and invoices spill into the mud. A polished placard blinks: INCIDENT RESPONSE EXPECTED WITHIN 3–5 BUSINESS DAYS.

blocks.label: Where You Are
blocks.body: A vendor cart lies sideways across the road. Produce and invoices spill into the mud. A polished placard blinks: INCIDENT RESPONSE EXPECTED WITHIN 3–5 BUSINESS DAYS.

blocks.label: Plain Stakes
blocks.body: The party finds a vendor cart blocking the road, with spilled produce, invoices, and a useless incident placard.
